description: This file defines a feature for listing tags within the Conduit application. It contains a query class representing the request, and a request handler class that interacts with the database context to fetch and return tags as a list of strings, wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents the request to list tags, implementing IRequest with a response type of TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query by querying the database context for tags, ordering them, and returning the results wrapped in a TagsEnvelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the tag listing request asynchronously, querying the database for tags, and returning them as a list of strings in a TagsEnvelope.
